beastmasters.name: Beastmasters' Charter
beastmasters.desc: Drakes and golems are fed from the city purse: cradles and foundries draw 40% less mana, but the tamers' scraps draw hounds: packs come 50% more often. 40 crowns/day.
beastmasters.flavor: Everything that eats can be tamed. Everything that is tamed still eats.

bounty.name: Hunters' Bounty
bounty.desc: A crown a pelt. Hunters' Lodges clear hounds twice as far, the Watch kills them more often, and thrumhares vanish from the meadows (they are pelts too).
bounty.flavor: The lodge door ran out of room for notches in a season.

closeseason.name: The Close Season
closeseason.desc: Wardens of the chase: no lodge takes game in Bloom while the herds drop their young (its hunters guard against hounds instead), no lodge takes a herd below 6 head, and the herds breed a quarter faster. 10 crowns a day and 10 a lodge.
closeseason.flavor: The hart is the Crown's in Bloom and the cook's in Ember. The wardens of the chase keep the calendar.

wyrmpeace.name: Wyrm-Peace
wyrmpeace.desc: A standing offering at the wyrm's node: tribute is halved, and so is the ward of a bound wyrm's lair. 80 crowns/day.
wyrmpeace.flavor: Half a hoard buys half a guardian. The wyrm can count.

scalemail.name: Scale-Mail
scalemail.desc: The Watch wears dragon scale: unrest −5 % while scale is in the vault, and the mail wears 0.05 scale a day. No crowns; the vault pays.
scalemail.flavor: It turns a knife. It also turns heads, which the Warden-Reeve counts as the point.

curfew.name: Night Curfew
curfew.desc: The Watch clears the streets after dark. Unrest −10, restless cleared faster; happiness −4.
curfew.flavor: "Halt. Are you living? Then go home."

draughts.name: Free Healing Draughts
draughts.desc: Moonwort draughts for every household. Health +12; costs 0.3 crowns per resident per day.
draughts.flavor: The alchemists grumble about the price. The children stop coughing.

rites.name: Rite Subsidy
rites.desc: The city pays the sextons. Boneyards and Ossuaries quiet 50% more dead. 25 crowns/day per deathcare building.
rites.flavor: Salt on the lips, a coin on the eyes, and now a second coin for Hollis.

wardens.name: Spire Wardens
wardens.desc: Tallowkin wardens watch the spires day and night. Wild surges only strike above 1.5× overdraw. 60 crowns/day.
wardens.flavor: They sleep in shifts under the obelisks and dream in blue.

herbgardens.name: Herb Garden Edict
herbgardens.desc: Every Craft yard must keep a glimherb bed. Goods production +25%, miasma +30%.
herbgardens.flavor: The alchemist's breath grows sweeter and thicker.

lanternlevy.name: Lantern Levy
lanternlevy.desc: Markets pay for the street lanterns. Market tithe +20%, market happiness −6.
lanternlevy.flavor: "It Moves," says the guild seal. "It Pays," says the Warden-Reeve.

imports.name: Import Goods
imports.desc: The Trade Depot buys goods for markets with empty shelves at twice the export price. Needs a Trade Depot.
imports.flavor: Potions from Vell-on-Sable, sold at Vell-on-Sable prices.

scholars.name: Scholars' Stipend
scholars.desc: Free schooling for Grimmen and Tallowkin children. Educated share grows 50% faster. 0.2 crowns per resident per day.
scholars.flavor: The girl who reads leystone like a book now has forty classmates.

drainage.name: The Drainage
drainage.flavor: The fen gives up an acre a week and the frogs file a complaint.
